The House Committee on Health offers Bill 54 (COMMITTEE SUBSTITUTE) By: Representatives Clark of the following substitute to HB 54: 100th, Jones of the 47th, Powell of the 33rd, Barrett of the 24th, Mathiak of the 82nd, and others
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Titles 16, 31, 43, and 48 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to crimes and offenses, health, professions and businesses, and revenue and taxation, respectively, so as … qualifying family member; and (B) Purchased or obtained from an organization or individual not related to the taxpayer or the qualifying family member."
SECTION 8. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
